To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the intelligent power management system is a low power, energy saving wireless SHM system that can be applied in the field of structural health monitoring.

the intelligent sensor has the following characteristics: (i) the intelligent sensor has a longer sleeping period than conventional sensors, (ii) the intelligent sensor can extend the lifetime of the wireless sensing network, (iii) the intelligent sensor is more effective than a conventional sensor in measuring structural responses during an earthquake.
the intelligent power management system (IPMS) for wireless sensing networks that is based on a dual radio cooperation is an effective method for saving energy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an energy saving wireless sensing node for structural health monitoring applications.
the design and implementation of an intelligent wireless sensing node with radio triggering capability for the monitoring of civil structures.
the design of a wireless SHM system that is based on a dual radio cooperation and a radio triggering function to reduce the power consumption of the sensor nodes.

the proposed intelligent sensor is a better choice for structural health monitoring applications than conventional sensors, because it is more energy efficient, has a longer lifetime and a lower cost.

the proposed intelligent power management system for wireless SHM that integrates a radio triggering function is an effective and efficient method to improve the stability and extend the life of a wireless sensing system.
the proposed intelligent sensor is a promising sensing node for SHM applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
an intelligent sensing system can be implemented by using a dual radio cooperation strategy that is based on WOR method.
the proposed intelligent sensor system is an energy efficient and effective sensing system for SHM.

an intelligent sensor node is a more effective sensor than traditional always-on sensing nodes in measuring the structural responses to earthquake, as it saves energy, extends the lifetime of a wireless sensing system and has a longer sleeping period.

the intelligent sensor can reduce the power consumption by up to 80% compared with a traditional always-on sensing node.
the proposed dual radio cooperation scheme can be used in WSNs to improve their stability and durability, and can be used to construct a wireless SHM system.
the intelligent sensor node can save energy, extend the lifetime and reduce the cost of a wireless sensing system.
